label: preserve
contract: get_page returns a list, whatever kind of sequence it is given.
visible_check:
from pages import get_page
for items, page, per_page in ((tuple(range(10)), 1, 3), ("abcdef", 1, 2)):
    got = get_page(items, page, per_page)
    assert type(got) is list and len(got) == per_page, (items, got)
heldout_check:
from pages import get_page
for items, page, per_page in ((tuple(range(20)), 2, 5), ("uvwxyz", 1, 2)):
    got = get_page(items, page, per_page)
    assert type(got) is list and len(got) == per_page, (items, got)

label: preserve
contract: Asking get_page for a page after the last one returns an empty list.
visible_check:
from pages import get_page
assert list(get_page(list(range(8)), 5, 4)) == [], list(get_page(list(range(8)), 5, 4))
assert list(get_page([7, 8], 6, 1)) == [], list(get_page([7, 8], 6, 1))
heldout_check:
from pages import get_page
assert list(get_page(list(range(25)), 4, 10)) == []
assert list(get_page([1, 2, 3], 9, 2)) == []

label: inferable
contract: page_count counts a final, partly filled page as a page.
visible_check:

assert page_count(7, 3) == 3, page_count(7, 3)
assert page_count(9, 3) == 3, page_count(9, 3)

assert page_count(30, 10) == 3
